description: 茨城県における想定地震ごとの建物被害 [buildings and earthquakes] is a dataset listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 防災・危機管理部. 茨城県における想定地震ごとの建物被害を250mメッシュで表したデータです。. Coverage: Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 防災・危機管理部. Its tags are 250mメッシュ, 国土, 地震, 建物被害, 茨城県. It offers 1 resource(s) in shp. The portal shows 2024-10-05 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
